entry.title: Hybrid modeling for improved structure prediction of large protein complexes
entry.summary:
Nature Computational Science, Published online: 15 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01067-w An automated framework, HDOCK-Multimer (HDM), is developed that integrates ab initio docking and combinatorial assembly for the structure prediction of large protein complexes. Across three benchmarks, HDM demonstrates increased accuracy and robustness in modeling large protein assemblies, compared with state-of-the-art…

entry.title: HDOCK-Multimer: improved structure prediction of large protein complexes by integrating docking and combinatorial assembly
entry.summary:
Nature Computational Science, Published online: 14 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01062-1 This study presents HDOCK-Multimer, a general framework for structure prediction of large protein complexes by integrating ab initio docking and combinatorial assembly, substantially outperforming state-of-the-art methods.

Source: Nature Computational Science · Tags: #bioinformatics #materials-science #genomics-proteins

entry.title: Ionic switching between supermagnetic states. Supermagnetic states are typically set during synthesis.
entry.summary:
Supermagnetic states are typically set during synthesis. Changing and retaining these states requires sustained external stimulus. Without resynthesis or continued stimulus, we show, for the first time, a reversible magneto-ionic switching between superferromagnetic (SFM) and superspin-glass (SSG) states using room-temperature Li-ion transport.

Source: arXiv Quantitative Biology (q-bio) · Tags: #bioinformatics #genomics-proteins
